title: Last-minute Halloween costumes for tech nerds
script:
TechCrunch just released three last-minute Halloween costume ideas for tech nerds.
You can dress up as a deceptively cute AI agent icon.
Another option is going as a terrifying PHP vulnerability.
You could also wear a biohacking look inspired by sleepy time Bryan Johnson.
These outfits lean into modern software bugs and automated assistants.
Would you wear an AI icon costume to your party?
